notes: Adds a clear Play again button to the final recap and generic scoreboard, separate from Return to lobby. Hosts replay the same game in the same room with the same players and rules; guests can request another round. UNO next-round replay preserves cumulative scores. Starting the next round closes stale end screens for every player. UNO View scoreboard reaches its existing round controls instead of a lobby-only overlay, and recap performance data is retained. Existing Back-to-lobby, Exit room, touch controls, saved scores and game designs are preserved.
